SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1933 North Winchester Avenue
From RS-3 to RM-4.5

The Property

The subject property is located in an RS-3 Single-Unit (Detached House) District and in a Transit Served Location
per the Chicago Zoning Ordinance as it is approximately 2,592 feet from the CTA Damen Blue Line Station.

The subject property is improved with a 2.5 story residential building containing five dwelling units and two
parking spaces. The height of the existing building is approximately 29.0 feet.

The Project

The subject property is improved with a 2.5 story residential building containing five dwelling units and two
parking spaces. The height of the existing building is approximately 29.0 feet. Four of the existing units are
grandfathered and the fifth unit is not currently grandfathered or allowed by the existing zoning. The Applicant
proposes to rezone the property to authorize the fifth existing residential unit and a previously erected dormer
‘on the roof of the building. No new additions or enlargements of the existing building are proposed. The
proposed rezoning is being sought as a Type 1 rezoning and as part of the Type 1 rezoning the Applicant also
seeks an administrative adjustment to reflect existing conditions by increasing the permitted unit count from
four units to five units under Section 17-13-1003-BB. The height of the building will remain at 29.0 feet.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,000 square feet

FAR: 1.37

Floor Area: 3,018 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 5

MLA Density: 600.00 square feet

Height: 29.0 feet

Bicycle Parking: None

Automobile Parking: 2

Loading Berth: 0

Setbacks: Front (Winchester): 4.90 feet
North (side): 0.75 feet
Rear: 51.6 feet
South (side): 3.15 feet

Attached is a set of plans.
